pre_return_execution_clarifications: Use the two preregistered formation profiles without selecting from later returns; evaluate all three candidates across all three windows.
A residual jumping across the mean also exits: sign(entry_z)*current_z<=0.5. This avoids missing the exit band when a four-hour observation overshoots it.
Failed hedges count as one cost-bearing attempted campaign, separately flagged. The100-lifecycle economic gate requires100closed hedge_matched campaigns; two legs never count as two wins.
Gross0.8 is an initial fill budget including entry costs and exit reserve. Marked gross drift is reported; no leverage or risk-budget increase. Any observed gross above equity fails admission.

Entry quantities use the prior close and prior completed-hour quote volume; submit both by a common available-volume fraction, then fill each independently at next5m adverse close. Remaining actual risk budget clips both equally after confirmed exits.
Unequal actual fill fractions queue real inventory for exit in the next interval; ownership of both symbols remains until flat. Pending exits persist through model change, risk halt and JSON restart.

Funding projection uses five complete past UTC daily sums from settled observations, excludes rebates as a gate benefit, and projects seven days. Actual funding uses observed event mark/rate, not that projection.
No forced terminal liquidation; open campaign settlement plus floating PnL and exit reserve reconciles NAV. Finite windows remain explicitly cold starts or continuous608days.
comparison: Read the already frozen trend static control at matching capital/window/cost from the first regime study with sealed result hashes; do not reselect controls on later returns. These reused controls are not additional independent accounts.
